top10.title: No Setup.exe / bundled runtime for normal-user install
Normal launch path depends on Node and optionally pnpm
Postgres/Redis optional infra down → DEGRADED startup
Full recovery fault-injection matrix not re-certified
Intermittent failure surface untested beyond 3 consecutive GW1 runs
Command palette / keyboard expert mode not runtime-mounted
Entity360 graph/timeline tabs are shell-level not deep investigation UX

exactNextRootCauseFix: Build and certify a self-contained Windows package (Setup.exe or SCI-OS-X10.exe) with embedded Node runtime and application assets so a normal user can Install → Click → READY → Search AAPL → Analyze without terminal, pnpm, or preinstalled Node.
